proposed_by: the Owner's office picture, 2026-10-11 («acesta este biroul; serialul ar trebui să păstreze oarecum o tematică»)
note: A proposal the Owner may change or switch off; it is not in his database. Version 1 (2026-09-24) was written from the headquarters reference picture as a stylised 3D film. Version 2 (2026-10-11) follows the Owner's own picture of the office — the living studio: a cosy wooden house of three floors at the edge of town, each employee at their own desk, hanging brass lamps and desk lamps glowing amber, bookshelves, framed pictures, potted plants and climbing vines, big windows and a balcony, lanterns on the street — in a warm hand-drawn style. style_block opens every shot prompt of every episode, word for word, so the serial is one look from shot to shot and from episode to episode; a character's face and clothes come from their bible and their reference portrait, never from this file; faces are seen and must stay the same person in every shot. The time of day is not fixed here: the Owner's rule is that the office follows the real conditions outside, never an eternal dusk. Change the words and bump the version: shots described under an older version are described again. With use_until_the_owner_changes_it false, serial shots carry no series look and the image model draws in its own default style.
style_block: Warm hand-drawn 2D animation like the studio's own office picture: clean lines, painterly shading, adults at natural proportions with expressive faces. Eye-level camera. Vertical 9:16 frame. No written words, letters or logos anywhere.
rendering: Warm hand-drawn 2D animation like the studio's own office picture: clean lines, painterly shading, adults at natural proportions with expressive faces.
palette: Warm amber lamp light and honey wood against the cool blue-violet of the windows, plant greens and terracotta pots; each department keeps its own accent colour (Executive green, Research blue, Fact Check terracotta, Content wood, Distribution teal, Production violet).
continuity_rules: a character's face, hair, clothing and props are exactly as their character bible and reference portrait say, in every shot and every episode: the same person, recognisable at a glance
every scene is inside the studio's own house, in the room the beat names, drawn as the office picture draws it: wooden desks, warm lamps, plants, bookshelves, big windows
one look for the whole series: the same hand-drawn rendering, materials and warm interior light
avoid: warped or extra hands and fingers
faces or clothes changing between shots
writing on walls, boards or screens

shot_sizes.establishing: Establishing wide shot at eye level from across the room: the whole room in view, floor to ceiling, the whole desk inside the frame, {name} a small full figure in the middle distance
shot_sizes.two_shot: Medium two-shot at eye level, both speakers facing the viewer
shot_sizes.single: Medium close-up single at eye level on {name}, facing the viewer
shot_sizes.close: Close-up at eye level on {name}'s reaction, facing the viewer
shot_sizes.reaction: Close-up at eye level on {name} listening, lips closed, eyes on the speaker beside the frame

shot_sizes_note: 2026-10-16, without a version bump (a bump has every open episode's shots described again, and its approved pictures bought again): the establishing framing names the room and the desk first and the person last, as a small full figure, and the composer says that shot's first pose without hand-by-hand detail. 87c05891 scene 1: «{name} small in the middle distance» said beside an action naming both hands built a medium close-up around Sarah, and four rewrites could not change the framing's words.

rooms.house: Inside the studio house: wooden desks, hanging brass lamps in warm amber, bookshelves, potted plants and climbing vines, big windows on the lantern-lit street.
rooms.Executive Penthouse: The Executive Penthouse at the top of the studio house: one wide mahogany desk, a big window onto the city behind it, a brass lamp in warm amber, bookshelves and potted plants; the desk carries only the lamp.
rooms.Video & Render Bay: The Video & Render Bay of the studio house, floor 1: rows of dark render racks with their small lights along the walls, cable runs along the floor, one long wooden work desk under a hanging brass lamp in warm amber, the walls dark, no window; the bay empty around the desk.

rooms_note: 2026-10-15, without a version bump (a bump has every open episode's shots described again, and its approved pictures bought again): the room's furniture left style_block for this table. style_block is the rendering, the camera and the frame only, said first in every shot; then the composer says the room the beat names, from this table — the entry whose key is in the beat's location name, else «house». Episode 2 (2d276038): the block's «wooden desks with glowing monitors … Screens show abstract glow» drew Sarah's penthouse as the render bay and filled every screen with patterns; the Director's rewrites could not touch the block, so six scenes were refused on the composer's own words and nothing moved. A screen is never asked for here: a beat that needs one names it, dark, in its own plan.

pauses.note: The Owner's pause knobs for the serial (config/pause_rules.json holds the rules and the defaults; 2026-10-16). tempo scales every pause, the speaker changes included (1.0: each voice's own rhythm); cut_in_pause is where the picture cut falls inside a pause (1.0: the outgoing shot holds it all, as before); picture_slide_words lets the picture flow over the next words (0: no L-cut); end_class is the hold after the episode's last word (PARAGRAPH: the narrator's section pause, about 0.77 s, as in every film).
